images.title: 7 m 9 cm and 790 cm as bars on one tape
images.purpose: Show two lengths in different units on one tape in cm: 7 m 9 cm changed to 709 cm and 790 cm, and the sign between them.
images.composition: A tape in cm at the bottom, two bars above it (teal for 7 m 9 cm, amber for 790 cm), the changed numbers at their ends and the sign in the middle.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TAPE: one horizontal line from x 128 to x 1328 at y 560 (1 cm is 1.5 px, so 800 cm is 1200 px) with exactly 9 tall tick marks (40 px) at x 128, 278, 428, 578, 728, 878, 1028, 1178 and 1328, labelled below in 36 px 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700 and 800, and the unit cm at the right end, x 1390, y 560. BAR 1 (top): one teal #0072B2 rectangle 1063 px long and 70 px high (x 128 to 1191, y 200 to 270) with the label 7 m 9 cm inside it at its left in white 44 px, and at its right end, just outside, the label 709 cm in 40 px (x 1210, y 235). BAR 2 (below it): one amber #E69F00 rectangle 1185 px long and 70 px high (x 128 to 1313, y 320 to 390) with the label 790 cm inside it at its left in dark 44 px. SIGN: a reddish purple #CC79A7 rounded box 560 by 80 px (x 448 to 1008, y 430 to 510) with the text 7 m 9 cm < 790 cm in 44 px bold. Two thin grey #6B7280 vertical lines from the bar ends down to the tape at x 1191 and x 1313. In all: 1 tape, 2 bars, 1 sign box. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a bar longer or shorter than stated
images.takeaway: Change both lengths to cm, then the numbers can be compared.
images.description: Two bars on one tape in cm: 7 m 9 cm which is 709 cm, and 790 cm, with 7 m 9 cm < 790 cm.
images.context: Concept image for Comparing Lengths in Different Units. It follows the idea of Ritika's rods in your maths book (lengths in different units compared with <, = and >) and shows the concept's own example, 7 m 9 cm and 790 cm (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Point at the two bar ends on the tape. The slip to watch: reading 7 m 9 cm as 7 m 90 cm and saying the two are equal.
